mentions.claim_text: The Lord tells him attention is being wasted on Iran and should go to Europe instead, because Europe is the bigger deal and they are going to try to cause a major war which will be a great war.
mentions.quote: Focus your attention on Europe. Europe's the bigger deal
mentions.falsify_match: A general war originating in Europe overtaking Iran as the dominant conflict story.
mentions.falsify_miss: Iran remains the larger conflict and Europe stays out of open war. This one is scoreable as a relative ranking of two theatres, which most of his war lines are not.

mentions.claim_text: He sees Putin dressed all in black, stiff like a board, becoming onyx, in connection with Iran and with Russia being part of it.
mentions.quote: Putin became a as stiff as a board and became Onyx
mentions.falsify_match: Putin taking a hardened, immovable position over Iran, refusing to move on it.
mentions.falsify_miss: Putin proves flexible or disengaged on Iran. The imagery is loose enough that a firm Russian statement would satisfy it, so the bar for a strong match is a formal Russian commitment to Iran.

mentions.claim_text: Putin becomes a black onyx tower with a sharp point rather than a flat top, which he compares to a sickle or an icicle and describes as looking like a weapon.
mentions.quote: Putin became a black onyx tower
mentions.falsify_match: Putin adopting a fixed, weaponised posture, publicly described as unyielding.
mentions.falsify_miss: Unfalsifiable as stated: a tower of onyx with a sharp point is imagery, not an event, and he supplies no reading of it here.

mentions.claim_text: The Lord tells him there is a leak and a mole in Ukraine.
mentions.quote: There's a leak. There's a mole in
mentions.falsify_match: A mole or leak inside the Ukrainian government or military being uncovered and reported.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such leak surfaces. Base rate note: espionage arrests in Ukraine are reported regularly, so only a leak at the level he implies would count.

mentions.claim_text: He sees purple over Poland and says Poland is there because it had the better weapons, with Ukraine out in front.
mentions.quote: Poland because they had better weapons
mentions.falsify_match: Poland taking a leading armed role in the war, with Ukraine still the front line.
mentions.falsify_miss: Poland stays out of the fighting. The purple colour is not glossed here, so only the Polish involvement is scoreable.

mentions.claim_text: He confirms seeing the Canadian prime minister sending troops and men to fight.
mentions.quote: Canada was trying to send troops to help
mentions.falsify_match: Canada announcing a deployment of combat troops to the European war.
mentions.falsify_miss: Canada sends no troops. Clean either-way test: a deployment is announced publicly or it is not.

mentions.claim_text: Italy and all of them are drawn into a major war which he likens to the Second World War but with bigger and much nastier weapons.
mentions.quote: It was a World War II but bigger weapons
mentions.falsify_match: A European war on a multi-nation scale using weapons more destructive than those of the Second World War.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such war. Sets a high and clearly observable bar, unlike the vaguer great war lines elsewhere in this video.

mentions.claim_text: England tries to take its boats into the Black Sea to come against this and Turkey blocks them.
mentions.quote: then Turkey blocked them
mentions.falsify_match: Turkey refusing passage to British naval vessels bound for the Black Sea.
mentions.falsify_miss: Turkey grants passage, or Britain never seeks it. Base rate note: the Montreux convention already blocks this in wartime, so a refusal would be the default rather than a surprise.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord is reaffirming that America's economy will be backed by Venezuela along with the finances of Colombia and Brazil, with big trade among those powers while a cartel is in trouble.
mentions.quote: the economy of America will be backed by Venezuela
mentions.falsify_match: American fiscal or currency support drawn from Venezuelan oil, with Colombian and Brazilian finance alongside it.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such arrangement forms with any of the three. The Colombia and Brazil half is the part that could clearly fail; the Venezuela half was already in motion when he said this.

mentions.claim_text: A major disruption involving the Mexican president, Mexico and the cartel is coming in the days ahead, with major civil unrest and people coming against the Mexican government.
mentions.quote: major civil unrest is coming to Mexico
mentions.falsify_match: Mass anti-government unrest in Mexico tied to the cartels, at a scale reported as a national crisis.
mentions.falsify_miss: No unrest beyond the usual. Base rate note: cartel violence and protest are constant in Mexico, so only a government-threatening scale would count.

mentions.claim_text: A new cold war is breaking out around Cuba and there is a major uprising in Cuba as it tries to flex with what it has.
mentions.quote: A major uprising in Cuba, trying to flex
mentions.falsify_match: A popular uprising in Cuba, or a Cuban military or diplomatic assertion against the United States.
mentions.falsify_miss: Cuba stays quiet. Uprising is ambiguous between a popular revolt and a state flex, which lets either reading claim a hit.

mentions.claim_text: China watches while the others fight it out, and he says to pay attention to China because it is being quiet and sneaky.
mentions.quote: you should pay attention to China because they're being
mentions.falsify_match: China staying out of a widening war while positioning itself, then moving.
mentions.falsify_miss: China is drawn into the fighting early, or takes no position at all. Watch-and-wait is the expected Chinese posture, so this is close to the base case.

mentions.claim_text: He repeats that a lady named Ursula is connected directly to Satanism, that the Lord called her a Satanist, and that George and other wealthy influential European leaders are with her.
mentions.quote: This woman is a Satanist
mentions.falsify_match: No public criterion; an accusation of hidden Satanism against a named official.
mentions.falsify_miss: Unfalsifiable as stated. Recorded because it is a repeat of the charge, not because it can be checked.

mentions.claim_text: Reading a headline that the United States has entered a deal with Venezuela covering 65 billion barrels of oil reserves, called the biggest oil deal in world history, he says this is what the Lord said and that the president is trying to stabilise the dollar.
mentions.quote: He's trying to stabilize the dollar
mentions.falsify_match: The dollar strengthening or holding on the back of the Venezuelan oil arrangement.
mentions.falsify_miss: The dollar weakens despite the deal. The headline itself is reported fact, not forecast; only the stated purpose is his claim and it is about intent, which is hard to refute.

mentions.claim_text: Comparing reserve figures read off the screen, 303 billion barrels against 209 billion and 45 billion, he says this is why the president went after Venezuela and that it holds more than Saudi Arabia and Canada.
mentions.quote: do you understand why he went after Venezuela?
mentions.falsify_match: Official confirmation that the Venezuela policy was driven by oil reserves rather than counter-narcotics.
mentions.falsify_miss: The policy turns out to be driven by drug interdiction as officially stated. This is a motive attribution about a past decision, not a forecast.

mentions.claim_text: He says they will call it a golden age.
mentions.quote: they'll call it a golden age
mentions.falsify_match: The administration or the press branding the coming period a golden age.
mentions.falsify_miss: Base rate note: the phrase golden age is already standing White House rhetoric, so this is near certain to land and should not score as a hit.

mentions.claim_text: A new oil boom will come forth with pipelines in America and in Texas, and he says to watch Texas and Oklahoma, having seen major money coming with oil.
mentions.quote: A new oil boom will come forth
mentions.falsify_match: A measurable production and investment boom in Texas and Oklahoma oil, with new pipeline construction.
mentions.falsify_miss: Texas and Oklahoma production flattens or falls and no new pipelines are built.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord showed them cyber attacks, without naming a target.
mentions.quote: The Lord showed us cyber attacks
mentions.falsify_match: A significant cyber attack on American infrastructure.
mentions.falsify_miss: Unfalsifiable in practice: no target, scale or date is named, and cyber attacks on American targets are reported continuously.

mentions.claim_text: He reads a report that Russia has warned it could strike British military targets over the United Kingdom's growing support for Ukraine.
mentions.quote: Russia has warned it could strike Britain military targets
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: a headline read off the screen, not a forecast he makes.
mentions.falsify_miss: Cannot fail as stated; the reporting is the source rather than a prediction.

mentions.claim_text: He says a Jason Bourne experience is coming for the Ukrainian president, that he will be here and then not, that people will wake up one morning and find him gone, and that they are going to make an example of him.
mentions.quote: I saw the uh Jason Bourne experience coming for Zalinski
mentions.falsify_match: The Ukrainian president disappearing, fleeing or being removed abruptly, and publicly made an example of.
mentions.falsify_miss: He remains in office. He softens it with I truly believe it rather than a flat word, which is worth noting against the stronger tellings in this thread.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are going to provoke a major war by striking the Kremlin in the days ahead.
mentions.quote: they're going to provoke a major major war as they strike the Kremlin
mentions.falsify_match: A strike that hits the Kremlin complex in Moscow, followed by a major escalation.
mentions.falsify_miss: No strike on the Kremlin. Base rate note: drones have reached Moscow before, so a strike near the city is not the same as hitting the Kremlin, which is what he names.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord had told them the Ukrainian president would become emboldened with France and the others, and that he will become even more emboldened.
mentions.quote: Zalinsky will he will become even more emboldened
mentions.falsify_match: The Ukrainian president taking visibly bolder positions or actions backed by France and the United Kingdom.
mentions.falsify_miss: He grows more cautious or is constrained by his backers. Emboldened has no threshold, so almost any assertive statement could be claimed as a hit.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Ukrainian president is about to receive weapons of longer reach, from the United Kingdom and France, and that this is what they are discussing.
mentions.quote: He's about to receive weapons of longer reach
mentions.falsify_match: A British or French transfer of longer-range strike weapons to Ukraine being announced.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such transfer. Base rate note: Storm Shadow and SCALP transfers were already public by 2023, so a further tranche would be a continuation rather than a new event.
